youtube_title: Why Every Diet Starts on MONDAY #Shorts
youtube_description:
It's called the fresh start effect (Wharton researchers Dai, Milkman & Riis): new week, new month, new year feels like a new you. In one study, people picked a goal date framed as 'the first day of spring' 3.5x more often (26% vs 7%) than the same date with a plain name. The catch: the feeling fades, the habit doesn't. Use the Monday boost, but keep it tiny, and restart the next day if you miss.
Source: Dai, Milkman & Riis, Psychological Science (2015); Management Science (2014).
